Staff briefings on a gentle week
This part of the manual describes what is expected

Companion Animal Travel Desk Care and Booking Standards

The purpose of this section is to guide staff in helping travelers arrange safe and respectful transport for companion animals on Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk must answer each request with calm attention, clear language, and a steady focus on the comfort of the traveler and the animal. Staff should listen carefully, confirm the details that affect acceptance for travel, and explain the next step in plain words. When a traveler raises a concern, the desk should respond promptly and with patience so that the process feels orderly and supportive.

All requests must be reviewed with the safety coordinator whenever there is any concern about containment, handling, or cabin conditions. The desk must not promise acceptance before the review is complete, and it must not suggest exceptions that have not been authorized. <<FACT F060>> Staff should record the traveler details, the animal type, and any care notes that affect safe transport, and they must share only the information needed by the relevant team members. If an animal appears unwell, agitated, or unable to travel safely, the staff member must advise the traveler that further review is required and must avoid casual assurances. The desk should keep its tone courteous and practical, even when the answer is not the one the traveler hoped to hear.

When travel is approved, staff should explain the handling expectations in a respectful way and remind the traveler to prepare the animal in a manner that protects welfare and prevents disturbance to others. The desk must avoid jargon and must never pressure the traveler into making a rushed choice. If a companion animal is traveling with a family group, the staff member should make reasonable efforts to coordinate the booking so the experience remains clear and calm. Where more information is needed, the desk should request it once and follow up without delay, so that the traveler does not feel abandoned or uncertain.

For any unresolved case, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor through the usual internal channel.
